The '''Small Blind''' is the first blind of each Ante. It can be skipped to receive a [[Tag]].

On {{Stake|Red}} and above and in 2 Challenge Decks (which are {{D|The Omelette}} and {{D|Cruelty}}), it provides no reward money, rather than the {{Money|3}} from {{Stake|White}}.

==Score Requirements==
{{Blind Score|multiplier=1}}

==Trivia==
===In other media===
*The Small Blind makes an [https://survivors.wiki/w/Small_Blind appearance] as a [https://survivors.wiki/boss boss enemy] in ''[[wikipedia:Vampire Survivors|Vampire Survivors]]''.
